purpose: Teach: 浩二/嶋/死因/船員/楽団/黒澤/柳田/真正面

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: スポンサー、本気で、絶対、浩二、絶対、さんの、絶対、ご支援、絶対、当社、絶対、感謝しております、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Koji-san, your support for our company means everything. I'm counting on you — truly.
lines.style: Formal, measured opening. Weight on gratitude. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone who respects both the listener and what he's asking. Not rushed — each phrase lands with intention.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。仕入れ先、本気で、絶対、嶋、絶対、商店、絶対、長年の取引、絶対、続いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Shima-san's store — our long partnership with them continues to be vital. We're grateful for that trust.
lines.style: Attentive, responsive. Slightly faster than the boss's pace but not eager. Confirming understanding with quiet competence. The voice of someone taking notes, not just listening.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の、本気で、絶対、死因、絶対、報道、絶対、当社、絶対、注視しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Watch the industry reports carefully. I need you paying attention to what's happening out there.
lines.style: Sharper edge than before. Directive, not consultative. Quick attack on 'watch.' Still composed but with urgency underneath. The tone shifts to command.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。物流の、本気で、絶対、船員、絶対、待遇、絶対、当社、絶対、改善、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're already working on improving conditions in our logistics division — particularly for our shipping partners. That's in progress.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. Slightly defensive in the best way — showing action already underway. Calm recitation of progress. The voice of someone making sure the boss knows they're ahead of the concern.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 会社主催の、本気で、絶対、楽団、絶対、コンサート、絶対、企画しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need the company to sponsor an orchestra concert. Plan it.
lines.style: Direct, almost abrupt. Short sentences. No elaboration. The tone of someone used to being obeyed. Clean attack, no warmth, all clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。映画祭の、本気で、絶対、黒澤、絶対、特集、絶対、当社、絶対、協賛、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We've already sponsored the film festival's Kurosawa retrospective. That commitment is done.
lines.style: Prompt, efficient. Matter-of-fact — stating completed action. Slightly quieter than the boss. The voice of someone checking boxes and moving forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 民俗学者、本気で、絶対、柳田、絶対、先生の、絶対、研究、絶対、商品開発、絶対、参考にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want you to reference the folklorist Yanagita-sensei's research in our product development. Use his work.
lines.style: Authoritative but with intellectual weight. Slower pace — this is not just a task, it's a principle. The tone of someone who reads and expects others to think deeply.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営課題、本気で、絶対、真正面、絶対、から、絶対、向き合ってまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're committed to facing our management challenges head-on, directly and without hesitation.
lines.style: Resolute closing. Steady, almost formal tone. A slight bow in the voice — respect and commitment in equal measure. The final word trails slightly with quiet determination.
